data.one_liner: Full‑stack Flutter framework offering Laravel‑style models, auth, routing, realtime and payments across all platforms.
data.what_it_does: Provides a container, facades, ORM‑like models, authentication, context‑free routing, validation, caching and localisation. Plugins extend it with realtime, payments, SQLite, notifications and more.
use_when: You need an all‑in‑one solution that mimics Laravel for a Flutter app
You want context‑free routing and built‑in auth/validation
You target Android, iOS, web, desktop with a single codebase
avoid_when: You only need a lightweight UI kit or simple HTTP client
You prefer a minimal set of packages rather than a large framework
weaknesses: Steep learning curve for Laravel concepts
Smaller community compared to mainstream packages
data.setup_notes: flutter pub add magic && dart run magic:dowel magic:install; add optional plugins with flutter pub add <plugin> && dart run magic:dowel plugin:install <plugin>
